additional_info.subject: Report of connectors showing an unavailable status Sicharge D Charging Station – S/N:   Y2/S2313522141001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to report an issue with a Sicharge D charging station, serial number Y2/S2313522141001.
Issue observed:
The station has been in an "connector out of operation" on the charge point, "unavailable" on the connector 1 DC CCS plug, 160kW and "available" on the connector 2 DC CCS plug,160kW,  since July 03, 2025 at 22 :00 :54, which is the time of the last status change.
Please investigate and take the necessary actions as soon as possible. We would also appreciate a report on the root cause and any corrective measures planned.
Best regards,
Janusan ESVARANATHAN | Supervision and maintenance engineer | Mob: +33 745 654 964
SAS AUTORECHARGE | WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR | +33 970 755 400

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435636-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / S2 313522141001] 1 DC CCS plug unavailable status CRM:02919000111
additional_info.body:
Hi Esv
aranathan,
Good Evening,
We have investigated the logs.
We could see the Failed Preconditioning of LEM 1.
We have rebooted the charger. Now, We could see there is active charging session on DC outlet 1.
Charger is at v6.0.3, We recommend having charge at latest FW. i.e. 7.0.5.
Since it has bug fixes. We request for your approval to update the charger.
Do let us know if you have any other query. else, confirm on closure of the case.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
